dataset.name: Crop Yiled with Soil and Weather.csv

methodology.preprocessing: StandardScaler fitted on the original training split and applied to the test split before selecting the quantum subsets.
pipeline: QKRR residual correction using FidelityQuantumKernel and ZZFeatureMap (5 dimensions, reps=2, full entanglement), lambda_reg=0.001
VQR residual correction using RealAmplitudes (5 qubits, reps=2, full entanglement), SPSA(maxiter=100)

evaluation.source: Executed notebook output for 'LR + QKRR + VQR Test Metrics'.

metric_source.note: Metrics are preserved from the notebook's executed final-hybrid cell. The original fitted LR VQR parameters were not persisted. A fresh VQR fit using the same notebook recipe and global seed produced R2=-17.026844, MAE=6.060537, MSE=60.334853, RMSE=7.767551, MAPE=73.916890%, so the recorded notebook metrics were not reproducible in this rerun. The original metrics have deliberately not been overwritten; see ../models/linear_regression_quantum/training_validation.json.
